Summary: The remaining payment after final checking is to be made within 28 working days of submission of the bill by the contractor.
Quote: The remaining payment is also to be made after final checking of the bill within 28 working days of submission of bill by the contractor.
Notes: Ad-hoc payment of not less than 75% is made within 10 working days. Delay beyond 45 days incurs simple interest at 5% per annum.

Unit: % of each running and final bill
Summary: 2.5% of each running and final bill is deducted as security deposit, up to a total cap of 2.5% of the tendered amount.
Quote: deduct a sum at the rate of 2.5% of the gross amount of each running and final bill till the sum deducted will amount to security deposit of 2.5% of the tendered amount of the work.
Notes: Referred to as security deposit collected from running bills and final bill.

Summary: Mobilization advances not exceeding 10% of the tendered amount may be given.
Quote: Mobilization advances not exceeding 10% of the tendered amount may be given, if requested by the contractor in writing within six months of the order to commence the work.
Notes: Bears simple interest at 8 percent per annum. Recovered by deductions from contractor's bills commencing after the first 10% of the gross value is executed and paid, until 80% is executed.

Summary: 0.75% of accepted tendered amount per month of delay, capped at 5% of the accepted Tendered Value.

Notes: To be computed on a per day basis. Page 33 mentions an additional combined recovery cap of 8% for clause 2 plus clause 3 upon contract determination.
